title: Answer operator questions from the pane, with a forgery guard that refuses model- or subagent-originated writes (seq 179b)
description:
opum-doc seq 179, item (b), relayed by opum-agent. Design: opum-doc docs/reference/operator-questions-in-quest-design.md at main, and questions-decisions-and-adrs.md.

The Quest board pane gains the interface for answering an operator question, and with it the guard that makes the answer trustworthy: a model or subagent must not be able to answer BY writing to the tracker behind the pane. The design specifies refusing model- or subagent-originated Bash, Edit and Write that answers a question or alters .quest/questions/.

The guard needs a positive control -- a check that a legitimate answer still gets through -- because a guard that refuses everything is indistinguishable from one that works until someone tries to answer.

acceptanceCriteria.text: The pane offers the answer interface the design specifies, and an answer given through it is recorded with the actor it was given as
A model- or subagent-originated Bash, Edit or Write that would answer a question or alter .quest/questions/ is refused
The guard has a positive control: a legitimate answer still succeeds, proven in the same invocation as the refusal
The guard behaves the same when the pane is closed
